content: If the Mirror_TxConfirmation reports the failed transmis- sion of a CAN destination frame ( result is E_NOT_OK ), the Bus Mirroring module shall report the runtime error MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next status frame.

If the Mirror_TxConfirmation reports the failed transmis- sion of a CAN destination frame ( result is E_NOT_OK ), the Bus Mirroring module shall report the runtime error Mirror.MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next status frame.

If the Mirror_TxConfirmation reports the failed transmis- sion of a CAN destination frame ( result is E_NOT_OK ), the Bus Mirroring module shall report the runtime error Mirror.MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next status frame.

If the Mirror_TxConfirmation reports the failed transmis- sion of a CAN destination frame ( result is E_NOT_OK ), the Bus Mirroring module shall report the runtime error MIRROR_E_TRANSMIT_FAILED , and shall set (to 1 ) the Frames Lost bit of the NetworkState of the next status frame.
